description: This file contains service functions for managing student data, including validation, CRUD operations via Supabase, filtering, sorting, and logging.

methods.name: validateStudent
methods.description: Validates a student object for required fields and correct formats.

methods.name: listStudents
methods.description: Fetches all students ordered by creation date.

methods.name: listStudentsFiltered
methods.description: Fetches students based on filters and sorting options.

methods.name: addStudent
methods.description: Inserts a new student record after validation.

methods.name: updateStudent
methods.description: Updates an existing student record by ID.

methods.name: deleteStudent
methods.description: Deletes a student record by ID.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Normalizes and cleans student data for database operations.
